name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.209: The IMDb/TMDb match loses its switch, and a spent allowance no longer starts the
    downloader. A filename-parsed title search could fetch a wrong-year release with the same name;
    the hard gate is the only position that stays correct, so the option went and not the gate. And
    the seeder now asks the SubDL counters once per scan, BEFORE it fills the download queue: with
    the 50/day download limit or the search allowance spent, the queue is not filled AND the run is
    refused, so a cycle stops costing its search allowance for saves that cannot happen. Measured on
    prod the day of the order: the download limit was spent from 05:59, and four further cycles each
    walked ~1000 queued items, spent the day's search allowance (59 -> 194) and saved nothing.
    An unreadable counter is NOT treated as spent - a network hiccup must not cost a day.
